'''Tristan Snowsill''' (GEMP handle '''TS-211''')<ref name="inf-snowsill">GEMP handle: a sealed-league sign-up gives "Tristan S / ts4079 / TS-211" (real name / forum name / GEMP screen name); the surname is given only as an initial, and Tristan Snowsill is the Retro League player it matches. Source: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1337390#p1337390 sign-up post by ts4079], in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=77430&start=60 Sealed league signups (page 4)], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013160112/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t77430-start60.html Internet Archive], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021062432/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t77430.html Internet Archive]</ref> is a [[Retro League]] player on [[GEMP]]. Snowsill's best result is 17th place in [[2023 Retro League Event 4]].<ref name="t82166" />
